en: Two quick cuts with the curved blade.

A stolen-grid spark that finds anyone.

A thin survey beam that tags its target.
A drone burns its battery in one blast.
A flick of the swift hilt that cuts a charge short.
The anvil hilt's slow and ruinous overhead strike.

Cast from salvaged ration-gate plates. Slower; teaches Crushing Blow.
Honed on a whetstone from the ration queue. Cuts deeper.
A wide blade that shoves foes back on every hit.
